detection.title: Object detection
detection.description: Photos with one or more items (and look-alikes) — all go into one shared pool.
detection.empty: Add photos from the camera or your gallery (up to {{count}} at a time).

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: 5–10 photos of the same physical item per form. Start a new form for every item.
classification.sameItem: Every photo must show exactly the same physical item.

limits.reached: You reached today's limit. More from {{time}}.

discard.title: Discard this form?
discard.text: The photos you added to this form will be lost.

classification.intro: To make the model as accurate as possible, please follow these guidelines:

angles.title: Different angles
angles.text: Rotate the item and take photos from different sides and perspectives.

lighting.title: Vary the lighting
lighting.text: Try different lighting conditions, but avoid extremely bright or dark images.

background.title: Change the background
background.text: Use different backgrounds to help the model focus on the item itself.

consistent.title: Keep the item consistent
consistent.text: Every photo must show exactly the same physical item.

distance.title: Vary the distance
distance.text: Feel free to experiment with camera distance, but keep the item clearly visible and avoid shots that are too far away.

tilts.title: Slight tilts
tilts.text: You can slightly tilt the item by a few degrees, but avoid extreme angles.

think.title: Think of it this way
think.text: Take photos that would make it easy for you to recognize the item, even if the angle, background, or lighting changes.

detection.intro: You can upload photos containing different items, multiple items in the same image, or a combination of items and other objects. You do not need to use the same item across all images.
detection.intro2: To help make the model more accurate and robust, please follow these guidelines:

differentItems.title: Different items
differentItems.text: Include as many different item designs, colors, and styles as possible.

multiple.title: Multiple objects
multiple.text: Feel free to include several items in a single photo.

distance.title: Vary the distance
distance.text: Take photos from different distances, but keep the objects reasonably visible.

background.title: Change the background
background.text: Use different surfaces and backgrounds to improve detection in various environments.

lighting.title: Vary the lighting
lighting.text: Include different lighting conditions, avoiding exclusively extremely bright or dark images.

tilts.title: Slight tilts
tilts.text: Experiment with small changes in camera and object angles, but avoid extreme tilts.

negatives.title: Hard negative examples
negatives.text: This is particularly important! Include some photos containing objects that look similar to the items but are NOT the items, such as objects with a similar shape, size, color or pattern. These help the model learn what it should NOT detect as an item.

important.title: Important
important.text: Not every image needs to contain all these variations. Try to create a diverse collection of realistic photos, including both items and visually similar objects that are not items.
